candidate_family_not_credited_as_stateme: For a source-selected nonzero entire complex function, or for source-selected discrete zero data, construct an exact source-selected canonical product using Weierstrass primary factors and account for the origin multiplicity and represent the residual zero-free entire factor as an exponential.
target_disposition: select and independently review one immutable source proposition before statement or proof execution
statement_blocker: The catalog gloss does not choose prescribed-zero construction versus factorization of a given function; define the entire predicate; exclude or classify the identically-zero function; encode the zero divisor, multiplicities, enumeration and local finiteness; separate the origin order; define primary factors and genus choices; specify local-uniform product convergence and the residual exponential; or select existence, converse and uniqueness clauses. Choosing a textbook formula at intake would add proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Open: an accepted source must fix Complex as scalar/domain, the given-function or prescribed-zero input, entire-function predicate, zero-data carrier and universes, multiplicity and local-finiteness conditions, product convergence semantics, and all typeclass context.
conclusion: Open: the repository does not select a construction or given-function root, the exact product equality, the primary-factor and genus witnesses, zero-divisor preservation, residual exponential, converse, uniqueness, or boundary clauses.
degenerate_case_status: No case is excluded at intake because no proposition is selected; statement work must resolve every zero-function, constant, finite-product, origin, multiplicity, enumeration, accumulation, convergence and normalization case listed in scope-map.md.
candidate_scope_not_credited: construction of an entire function with a prescribed locally finite zero divisor
factorization of a given nonzero entire function into an origin power, zero-free exponential and canonical product
a checked equivalence between the prescribed-zero and given-function formulations
Hadamard factorization under finite-order growth hypotheses
a finite-support meromorphic zero/pole extraction theorem
Euler's sine product as a special case
degenerate_cases_to_resolve: the identically-zero function and the nonzero-input hypothesis
nonzero constants and entire functions with no nonzero zeros
finitely many zeros, polynomial cases and empty or finite products
zero at the origin with multiplicity zero or positive finite multiplicity
repeated nonzero zeros and invariance under enumeration or permutation
a proposed zero sequence containing zero or having a finite accumulation point
genus values including zero and the exact growth or summability condition
pointwise, compact-uniform or locally uniform product convergence
existence, converse, equality, normalization and uniqueness boundaries
excluded_substitutions: THM-M-0265 Weierstrass approximation, THM-M-0266 Stone-Weierstrass, or THM-M-0264/THM-M-0619 Bolzano-Weierstrass
Hadamard finite-order factorization silently substituted for the unrestricted theorem
Complex.canonicalFactor, which is a disk/Blaschke factor rather than the primary factor E_p
MeromorphicOn.extract_zeros_poles, which assumes finite divisor support and uses a finite product
Complex.tendsto_euler_sin_prod or another single-function infinite-product identity
a structure field or hypothesis that directly stores the requested factorization or zero-divisor equality
a generic infinite-product convergence theorem, theorem name, API check, or the catalog's untrusted verified label
